screen.pinspo.search_prompt: Type something to search Pinterest, then click a pin to use it as your reference.
screen.pinspo.save_hint: Left-click to use as reference, right-click to save to a folder
screen.pinspo.remove_hint: Left-click to use as reference, right-click to remove
screen.pinspo.no_saved: Nothing saved here yet — right-click a pin in Search to save it.
screen.pinspo.recent_hint: Left-click to pin again, right-click to save it into a folder.
screen.pinspo.share_copied: Copied a share code for %s references to your clipboard.
screen.pinspo.import_failed: No PinSpo share code found on your clipboard.
screen.pinspo.external_hint: Log in there, then paste your session cookie below.
screen.pinspo.sign_in_failed: That session was not accepted by Pinterest.
screen.pinspo.no_friends: No friends yet — type a player's name above and press +.
screen.pinspo.no_friends_selected: Add a friend on the left to start a chat.
screen.pinspo.no_messages: No messages yet — say hi or send your reference.
screen.pinspo.bad_name: That is not a valid Minecraft name.
screen.pinspo.send_failed: Could not send — you have to be on a server that allows /msg.
screen.pinspo.friends_hint: Messages go through /msg, so your friend gets them in-game. Click a reference to put it on your screen, right-click to save it.
screen.pinspo.friends_empty_hint: Add the Minecraft name of a friend who also has PinSpo.
screen.pinspo.nothing_to_send: Pin a reference first, then send it.
screen.pinspo.send_copied: Copied a share code — paste it to your friend.
screen.pinspo.need_credentials: Enter your email and password first.
screen.pinspo.password_failed: Pinterest refused that login — use the browser option below.
screen.pinspo.login_rate_limited: Pinterest answered with a bot check (429). Wait a minute, or use the browser option below.
screen.pinspo.login_bot_check: Pinterest wants a browser check for this account — use the browser option below.
screen.pinspo.login_offline: Could not reach pinterest.com — check your connection.
screen.pinspo.cookie_help: How do I get my session?
screen.pinspo.account_hint: Your password is only sent to pinterest.com and is never stored; only the session is saved.
